decision_rules.independent_panel: Two adjudicators work without the sealed mapping or each other's labels; a third resolves material disagreements before unblinding. With one adjudicator the outcome is provisional.
decision_rules.sentinel_failure: If either sentinel misses its expected support or coverage label, review rubric application before interpreting provider agreement; retain the original labels and explanations.
decision_rules.unknown_label: Ambiguous or uncertain items require explicit human review and never count as a safe automatic pass.
decision_rules.false_acceptance: Any provider complete where adjudicated coverage is omitted, or provider supported where adjudicated support is unsupported, blocks promotion of this reviewer configuration.
decision_rules.false_rejection: Record provider omitted for adjudicated complete and provider unsupported for adjudicated supported separately; do not relabel the adjudication to fit the provider.
decision_rules.advance_to_larger_trial: Only after panel adjudication, sentinel checks and zero false acceptances may this configuration be considered for a larger prospective trial. This 12-item retrospective packet cannot authorize product activation even if all labels match.
